name: George Lincoln Rockwell
role: Founder and commander of the American Nazi Party (1959–1967)
summary: Rockwell was an open American neo-Nazi who held that the white Aryan race is superior, that a Jewish-Communist-Zionist conspiracy threatens it, and that it should be unified worldwide under strong leaders. He called democracy a fraud, wanted an all-white America with Black Americans moved to Africa, and opposed the UN and foreign aid. His recorded economics are thin and mostly condemn "parasitic" finance.

strong-leader.rationale: He says humanity should be led by the strongest and wisest individuals, like a wolf pack by its strongest wolf, instead of by democratic majorities (This Time the World, ch. XIX–XX); the program asks for government by responsible leaders in place of party politics.

state-harmful.rationale: He and his party aim to win and run a government (an Aryan-dominated state with vigilance against internal enemies), so abolishing the state contradicts his stated aim.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: He calls the United Nations the planned "final graveyard of all national liberty" and of the White race, and condemns it as a Jewish-Communist body (ch. XX).

revolution-justified.rationale: In "In Hoc Signo Vinces" he says the goal needs a planned "world counter revolution" against the Jewish-Marxist one, while in This Time the World he says power must be won legally and by elections; the first points against the statement more than the second.

democracy-best.rationale: He calls democracy a Jewish "monstrous fraud" and a mutiny of inferiors against natural leaders (ch. XIX–XX).

natural-rulers.rationale: He says humanity needs leadership by its naturally superior individuals and aristocrats, like a wolf pack's strongest leader (ch. XIX).

political-violence-never.rationale: He says "ruthlessly use whatever force might be necessary" and warns of white violence if economics collapse (s2, s1), but in This Time the World he says power must be won legally, within the law and the Constitution (s1); his own words point both ways.

ethnic-nation.rationale: His program demands an all-White America in which White people are the sole masters of their destiny, and he wants all Aryan peoples united in one political entity.

civilizational-union.rationale: He wants all white Aryan peoples in one political entity and a World Union of National Socialists across the white countries (ch. XX).

duties-before-rights.rationale: He condemns liberalism for pampering the individual at the expense of the species, and the program puts duties to future generations ahead of the "selfish whims of the present" (ch. XIX).

media-academia-power.rationale: He says a Jewish-controlled media and entertainment industry shapes what voters know and that elected politicians are its marionettes (ch. XX).

hereditarian-race.rationale: He writes that "inferior races" and the "black savages" are inferior and that scientific breeding must apply to humans, with the white race superior by heredity (ch. XIX).

national-rebirth.rationale: The program calls for a spiritual rebirth of the people and he calls for destroying a rotten society and building a Nazi one in its place (ch. V, XX; program).

work-for-welfare.rationale: The program says there is no place for parasites who draw their sustenance from society without giving anything in return; he also attacks "welfare-ism" (ch. XIX).

racial-segregation-law.rationale: He wants separate areas for each race and an America without Black people in schools, buses and workplaces; he calls the integration laws illegal and says the remedy is to change them (ch. XVIII, XX; program).

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: He and the program say party politics gives rise to hypocritical and unscrupulous leaders and that both parties betray the people ("Republicrats and Democans") (ch. XX).

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: He condemns keeping "drooling idiots" and "two-headed monsters" alive to procreate and wants scientific breeding applied to human beings so each generation is of higher quality.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: The program calls for children who date and marry within their own race, never "raceless mongrels", and he denounces "race-mixing" throughout.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He rejects racial equality outright, calling it a Jewish hypocrisy, and wants separate and unequal roles for "inferior" races (ch. XIX–XX).

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: He disparages "hot-house intellectuals" and college "intellectuals" who despise their heritage (ch. XIX–XX).

cultures-equal-different.rationale: He calls "negroid" culture degeneracy and Aryan culture the source of civilization; the program breaks the "alien" influence on art and music.

death-penalty.rationale: He says traitors proven guilty in court, before juries, should go to the gas chambers, and that those who run the Communist conspiracy should be destroyed (ch. XIX–XX); this is execution for treason, not terrorism by name.

restrict-pornography.rationale: He lists pornography among the things a Nazi government would clean America of (ch. XX).

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: He wants to stop foreign aid, calling it wasted money buying friendship from enemies (ch. XVIII, XX).

character-from-environment.rationale: He stresses heredity and breeding over environment and says the Jew "deprecated all ideas of heredity, breeding, race" (ch. XIX).

leader-cult.rationale: He dedicates his book to Hitler as a persecuted saviour, keeps an altar to him, and speaks of Hitler as the "new savior" (ch. V, dedication).

kin-peoples-union.rationale: He declares an intention to incorporate all Nordic and Aryan white peoples into a single political entity (ch. XIX).

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: He says white domination of "savage Africa" is like parents guiding helpless children, and that its withdrawal brings catastrophe (ch. XX).

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: He dedicates his book to Hitler and treats anti-Nazi democracy as a Jewish fraud, so he rejects anti-fascism as a founding value.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: The program wants to turn people from materialism, cynicism and egoism to racial idealism and puts quality of people above gadgets.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: He asserts a Jewish-Zionist-Bolshevik criminal conspiracy against the white race and nation (dedication, ch. XIX–XX; In Hoc Signo Vinces).

defeat-communism.rationale: He declares a goal of utterly destroying those who organise the Communist conspiracy and a "burning desire" to massacre Bolshevik leaders, and says Communism threatens the world (ch. XIX–XX).

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: He calls both Communism and capitalism "Jewish economic swindles" that set white men against each other (ch. XIX–XX).

holocaust-denial.rationale: A scholarly entry says he popularised Holocaust denial in the US; he calls accounts of Nazi atrocities Jewish "lies" and "hoaxes" and mocks survivors' tales of camps and showers (ch. XVIII, XX).

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The program wants an economy based on the interests of those who work, not those who live by renting out capital, and ends parasites living off society.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: He writes that the struggle is "far more than a battle for political supremacy" but a smashing of a rotten society by a Nazi one, which he compares to early Christianity (ch. V).

person-over-state.rationale: He subordinates the individual to the race and species and condemns pampering the individual (ch. XIX).

spiritual-nature.rationale: The program calls for a spiritual rebirth and a new faith based on racial idealism, which politics should bring about.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The program demands a foreign policy based only on the long-term interests of the white race and White world solidarity.

racial-pride.rationale: He declares the goal of Aryan white domination and writes of the white race's heritage and genius as the source of civilization.

future-generations.rationale: The program says the environment must be kept clean and resources conserved, and puts duties to future generations ahead of present whims.

race-social-construct.rationale: He says the real boundaries of nature are set by RACE, and that race is a biological reality the scientific method should be applied to (ch. XIX).

promote-ethnic-return-migration.rationale: He proposes a government-funded programme (cash bonuses, buying their holdings, transport, setting them up) to move American Black citizens to Africa (ch. XX).

democracy-becomes-oligarchy.rationale: He says democracy ends up run by the "smartest demagogue" or by those who control the media instead of by the people (ch. XIX–XX).

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: He proposes moving some fifteen million Black Americans to Africa, mainly as paid "voluntary repatriation" but also speaks of finishing the movement "to Africa or to reservations here" in one term (ch. XX).

notes: Answers rest on his own words (This Time the World, written 1960-61, and essays); no record-based evidence cited. Searched all themes: race and Jews, government and democracy, UN and foreign policy, economy, environment, family and sex, religion. Almost no stated positions on economic policy detail, social policy, technology, trade or healthcare, so those stay null. Several of his statements are tactical (legal route to power, free speech for Nazis); only explicit positions are recorded.
